types.name: ledger.v1.AccountCode
types.doc: AccountCode identifies the ledger account bucket affected by a transfer.

values.name: FUNDING
values.doc: User funding bucket.

values.name: TRADING
values.doc: User trading bucket.

types.name: ledger.v1.TransferCode
types.doc: TransferCode identifies the product reason for a transfer.

values.name: DEPOSIT
values.doc: External deposit into a funding account.

values.name: WITHDRAW
values.doc: External withdrawal from a funding account.

values.name: MAKER_FEE
values.doc: Maker fee charged for a trade.

values.name: TAKER_FEE
values.doc: Taker fee charged for a trade.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER
values.doc: Internal account transfer.

values.name: TRADE_BASE
values.doc: Spot trade base-asset leg.

values.name: TRADE_QUOTE
values.doc: Spot trade quote-asset leg.

values.name: REBATE
values.doc: Rebate transfer.

values.name: FUNDING_TO_TRADING
values.doc: Funding-to-trading user bucket transfer.

values.name: TRADING_TO_FUNDING
values.doc: Trading-to-funding user bucket transfer.

values.name: TRADING_WITHDRAW_RESERVE
values.doc: Reserve leg for a trading withdrawal.

values.name: FUNDING_USER_TRANSFER
values.doc: Funding user-to-user transfer.

values.name: TRADING_WITHDRAW_REQUEST_FEE
values.doc: Non-refundable on-chain request fee retained when a submitted trading withdrawal fails.

values.name: TRADING_WITHDRAW_FEE_LEG
values.doc: Fee paid to a fee recipient when a trading withdrawal completes.

values.name: QUICKSWAP_POLYESTER_FEE
values.doc: QuickSwap fee paid to Polyester in the received asset.

values.name: QUICKSWAP_BROKER_FEE
values.doc: QuickSwap fee paid to a broker in the received asset.

values.name: QUICKSWAP_AFFILIATE_FEE
values.doc: QuickSwap fee paid to an affiliate in the received asset.

values.name: FEE_SWEEP
values.doc: Collected fees transferred to the fee treasury's trading account.

values.name: FEE_REFILL
values.doc: Funds transferred from the fee treasury's trading account to replenish fee funds.

values.name: SYSTEM_ADJUSTMENT
values.doc:
Balance adjustment with a system account, including account seeding credits or corrections.
 May credit or debit the user's account; the transfer direction identifies which.
